title: Prisma Relations
description: Master Prisma relations including one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-many, implicit and explicit many-to-many relations.
longDescription: Relations are at the heart of relational databases. This module teaches you how to define and query relations in Prisma, including one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-many (both implicit and explicit), and how to work with relation queries and filters.
whatYouLearn: Work with many-to-many relations (implicit and explicit)
